implementation: Shared WebGL 2 material renderer for classic and pixel town
artwork: Existing day/night illustrations retain their composition, palette and lighting. No replacement terrain or foliage sprite is shipped.

modules.WorldEnvironment.tsx: Asset loading, requestAnimationFrame lifecycle, context loss recovery and still-art fallback.
modules.materials.ts: Scene-specific material regions. Daylight color classification provides water, foliage, grass and cloud channels. Raw RGBA upload avoids canvas alpha premultiplication.
modules.materialRenderer.ts: Continuous water refraction and local ripples; trunk-anchored canopy movement with delayed branch response; coherent grass wind and light; slow cloud displacement and ground shadows; day/night interpolation.
modules.pixelScene.ts: Pixel destination coordinates, independent of classic navigation coordinates.
modules.types.ts: Small shared runtime contract for lighting, player position and local water events.

motionDesign.refresh: 15 ms minimum interval, continuous delta time; no pixel-step rounding of movement
motionDesign.wind: Grass and canopies share a moving gust, branch response is delayed by height and position.
motionDesign.water: Two superimposed waves displace existing water/reflection detail while shoreline samples attenuate motion.
motionDesign.night: Blend actual authored night artwork instead of darkening daytime artwork.
motionDesign.reducedMotion: Disable displacement/light cycles and apply lighting changes immediately.
motionDesign.backgroundTabs: Stop animation when document is hidden; discard elapsed hidden time on resume.

limits: Art is still an atlas with independently animated material regions, not a tile/entity editor or a full physics simulation.
Objects embedded in the artwork do not yet have separate collision or depth meshes.
No automated tests added or run; TypeScript and Vite build run.

discardedApproach.reason: User rejected newly added rotating cutout trees, procedural cartoon clouds/ducks and decorative particles as too Flash-like. Removed those renderers, their generated assets, and old CSS sparkle overlays.
